def kdtree(arr, depth)
  return nil if arr.size == 0
  k = arr[0].size - 1
  axis = depth % k

  sorted = arr.sort_by{|x| x[axis]}
  median = sorted.size / 2

  node.left = kdtree(sorted[0,median], depth+1)
  node.right = kdtree(sorted[median+1..-1], depth+1)
  return node
end

class KDTree
  Node = Struct.new(:location, :left, :right)

  attr_reader :points, :nodes

  def initialize(points)
    @points = points.dup
    @nodes = []
    @pos = 0
  end

  def build(l, r, depth=0)
    return nil unless l < r

    mid = (l + r) / 2

    pos = @pos
    @pos += 1

    if depth % 2 == 0
      @points[l...r] = @points[l...r].sort! {|a, b| a.x <=> b.x }
    else
      @points[l...r] = @points[l...r].sort! {|a, b| a.y <=> b.y }
    end

    node = Node.new

    node.location = mid
    node.left = build(l, mid, depth + 1)
    node.right = build(mid + 1, r, depth + 1)

    @nodes[pos] = node

    pos
  end

  def find(id, x1, x2, y1, y2, depth=0)
    ret = []

    node = @nodes[id]
    point = @points[node.location]

    x = point.x
    y = point.y

    if x1 <= x && x <= x2 && y1 <= y && y <= y2
      ret << point
    end

    if depth % 2 == 0
      if node.left && x1 <= x
        ret.concat(find(node.left, x1, x2, y1, y2, depth + 1))
      end

      if node.right && x <= x2
        ret.concat(find(node.right, x1, x2, y1, y2, depth + 1))
      end
    else
      if node.left && y1 <= y
        ret.concat(find(node.left, x1, x2, y1, y2, depth + 1))
      end

      if node.right && y <= y2
        ret.concat(find(node.right, x1, x2, y1, y2, depth + 1))
      end
    end

    ret
  end
end

class TDTree
  def initialize
    @points = []
    @nodes = []
  end

  def add_point(point)
    node = Node.new(point)
    @nodes << node
    return if root == node

    parent = root
    depth = 0
    loop do
      method = depth.even? ? :x : :y
      if point.send(method) < parent.point.send(method)
        unless parent.left
          parent.left = node
          break
        end
        parent = parent.left
      else
        unless parent.right
          parent.right = node
          break
        end
        parent = parent.right
      end
      depth += 1
    end
  end

  def search(range, node = root, depth = 0, results = [])
    point = node.point
    if range.member?(point)
      results << point
    end

    if depth.even?
      if node.left && range.sx <= point.x
        search(range, node.left, depth + 1, results)
      end
      if node.right && point.x <= range.tx
        search(range, node.right, depth + 1, results)
      end
    else
      if node.left && range.sy <= point.y
        search(range, node.left, depth + 1, results)
      end
      if node.right && point.y <= range.ty
        search(range, node.right, depth + 1, results)
      end
    end

    results.tap { |r| r.sort_by!(&:id) if depth == 0 }
  end

  def root
    @nodes.first
  end
end

    # @p = p
    @t = Array.new(n)
    @np = 0
    makeDTree(0, n, p, 0)
  end

  def makeDTree(l, r, p, axis)
    unless l < r
      return nil
    end

    mid = (l + r) / 2
    t = @np
    @np += 1

    new_p = p[l...r].sort_by{ |p| p[axis] }
    # puts "l: #{l}, r: #{r}, depth: #{depth} px: #{@p.map{|p| p.x}}, py: #{@p.map{|p| p.y}}"
    # puts "l: #{l}, r: #{r}, mid: #{mid}, new_p: #{new_p}"
    node = new_p[mid - l]
    @t[t] = node
    axis ^= 1
    @t[t][3] = makeDTree(0, mid - l, new_p, axis)
    @t[t][4] = makeDTree(mid+1 - l, r - l, new_p, axis)

    return t
  end

  def find(v, sx, tx, sy, ty, ans, axis)
    x = @t[v][0]
    y = @t[v][1]

    if sx <= x && x <= tx && sy <= y && y <= ty
      ans << @t[v][2]
    end

    if axis.zero?
      axis ^= 1
      if @t[v][3] && sx <= x
        find(@t[v][3], sx, tx, sy, ty, ans, axis)
      end
      if @t[v][4] && x <= tx
        find(@t[v][4], sx, tx, sy, ty, ans, axis)
      end
    else
      axis ^= 1
      if @t[v][3] && sy <= y
        find(@t[v][3], sx, tx, sy, ty, ans, axis)
      end
      if @t[v][4] && y <= ty
        find(@t[v][4], sx, tx, sy, ty, ans, axis)
      end
    end
  end

    @points = points.dup
    @nodes = []
    @pos = 0
  end

  def build(l, r, depth=0)
    return nil unless l < r

    mid = (l + r) / 2

    pos = @pos
    @pos += 1

    if depth % 2 == 0
      @points[l...r] = @points[l...r].sort_by {|p| p.x }
    else
      @points[l...r] = @points[l...r].sort_by {|p| p.y }
    end

    node = Node.new

    node.location = mid
    node.left = build(l, mid, depth + 1)
    node.right = build(mid + 1, r, depth + 1)

    @nodes[pos] = node

    pos
  end

  def find(id, x1, x2, y1, y2, depth=0)
    ret = []

    node = @nodes[id]
    point = @points[node.location]

    x = point.x
    y = point.y

    if x1 <= x && x <= x2 && y1 <= y && y <= y2
      ret << point
    end

    if depth % 2 == 0
      if node.left && x1 <= x
        ret.concat(find(node.left, x1, x2, y1, y2, depth + 1))
      end

      if node.right && x <= x2
        ret.concat(find(node.right, x1, x2, y1, y2, depth + 1))

    else
      if node.left && y1 <= y
        ret.concat(find(node.left, x1, x2, y1, y2, depth + 1))
      end

      if node.right && y <= y2
        ret.concat(find(node.right, x1, x2, y1, y2, depth + 1))
      end
    end

    ret
  end

    @points = []
    @nodes = []
  end

  def add_point(point)
    node = Node.new(point)
    @nodes << node
    return if root == node

    parent = root
    depth = 0
    loop do
      method = depth.even? ? :x : :y
      if point.send(method) < parent.point.send(method)
        unless parent.left
          parent.left = node
          break
        end
        parent = parent.left
      else
        unless parent.right
          parent.right = node
          break
        end
        parent = parent.right
      end
      depth += 1
    end
  end

  def search(range, node = root, depth = 0, results = [])
    point = node.point
    if range.member?(point)
      results << point
    end

    if depth.even?
      if node.left && range.sx <= point.x
        search(range, node.left, depth + 1, results)
      end
      if node.right && point.x <= range.tx
        search(range, node.right, depth + 1, results)
      end
    else
      if node.left && range.sy <= point.y
        search(range, node.left, depth + 1, results)
      end
      if node.right && point.y <= range.ty
        search(range, node.right, depth + 1, results)
      end
    end

    results.tap { |r| r.sort_by!(&:id) if depth == 0 }
  end

  def root
    @nodes.first
  end
end

               for i in range(0, self.n, self.root)]
